title: K-HNSW Run Manifest Schema
description: Metadata manifest schema for recording reproducible benchmark experiment runs.

created_utc.description: UTC timestamp when the experiment run was initiated.

git_commit.description: Git commit SHA at the time of execution.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the experiment configuration file.

seed.description: Random seed used for deterministic reproducibility.

dataset.description: Name or identifier of the dataset used.

library_versions.description: Map of dependencies and their exact installed version strings.

metrics_files.description: Relative paths to output metrics files produced by the run.

notes.description: Freeform context or observations regarding the experiment run.
